text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, just as we were about to start
a meeting in the trainer's office...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono.
I have an earnest request to make.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...In the upcoming mock race.
I would like you to let me run in it.
choice_data_list: But we still have our target race coming up—are you going to be okay?
But we still have our target race coming up—are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Naturally, I will not let down my guard. I intend to approach both races with the absolute resolve to win.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Therefore... I humbly beg of your forgiveness.
What do you say?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "And in the end, I decided to respect Yaeno Muteki's strong resolve, but..."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for your guidance today as well!
...Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Ever since that day, the moment training concludes,
Yaeno Muteki has been leaving in a hurry."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while I was wondering if she was hiding something from me,
I finished running errands in town and was walking back to the Academy—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Gasp!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Heading toward the spirited shouts,
there stood Yaeno Muteki in her racing outfit,
solitarily training.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...I knew by the presence drawing near.
It truly was you, after all.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"I apologize for taking it upon myself to do unscheduled training.
It's just... I wanted to sharpen my body and mind to the absolute limit, no matter what."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...For I cannot afford to fall behind in the slightest during this upcoming mock race.
choice_data_list: Why would you go that far...?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —The other day, I received a "challenge letter."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—"Having observed your running in the recent race, I perceive you are a person of considerable skill.
I shall defeat you and make it my renown."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Let us compete to our hearts' content in the upcoming mock race."
...That is what was written
in the letter of challenge.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"To refuse a challenge is not the way of the Yaegaki.
With a mind free of the slightest opening,
I shall present myself at the field of duel... Or so I resolved."
choice_data_list: Still... can your body hold up?
Still... can your body hold up?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
No need to worry. This Racewear
fills every inch of my body with vigor.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Because... this racing attire is, so to speak,
my official license.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed. Only GⅠ contenders wear signature racewear.
Defeating them allows one to make a name for themselves instantly.
It is the 'mark of the strong.'"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
In the Kongo Yaegaki style...
I believe this is equivalent to receiving
the "Mokuroku" license.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
As a certified master of the scroll, 'weakness' is unforgivable.
At all times, one must be a protector of loved ones, of the weak,
and of one's pride.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: "Our seniors would run through night mountains, chop through driftwood with bare hands, heave massive boulders, and greet the sunrise with a thousand strikes against a great bell—all while keeping completely cool and composed."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
No matter how dire the circumstances,
my "strength" will never waver.
That is the way of the Yaegaki—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—Clad in this outfit, I too wish to be
among the "strong"
who will never yield to anyone, not even myself.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, even if I am challenged to a duel again in the future,
I do not wish to run away. Each time, I will simply
display the "strength" of the Yaegaki.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Master. Won't you please allow
this unworthy disciple to see her resolve through?
choice_data_list: Let's show them the strength of someone who wears a racing outfit!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: "Ossu!! Then let us resume our training!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And Yaeno Muteki continued her training.
Harmonizing mind, technique, and body to the absolute limit,
the outcome of the mock race she challenged was..."

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"The final straight! Here comes Yaeno Muteki,
moving up! Yaeno Muteki takes the lead!
Pulling away by 3 lengths to cross the finish line!!"

text_block_list.name: Surprised Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! She was utterly dominant, wasn't she!?
Even though the runner-up kept dogging her heels till the very end...!

text_block_list.name: Knowledgeable Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"...No. The race's flow, the rivals' movements—
he saw through it all like clear water. He won...
just as a true master was destined to win."

text_block_list.name: Sender of the Challenge
text_block_list.text:
—Splendid. You bested me in every aspect.
...Looks like I must start my training over from scratch.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...It was solely because of that pledge
that I grew stronger.
I thank you from the bottom of my heart."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you for bearing witness, Trainer.
Was I able to display... the spirit of the Kongo Yaegaki style?
choice_data_list: I caught a glimpse of the true strength of the Kongou Yaegaki style.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Ossu! I believe all of this is
the fruit of daily discipline."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...And my ability to continue my daily training
without hesitation comes solely from the belief
that the path I walk is not mistaken."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
In other words... it is precisely because
I can truly believe from the bottom of my heart in the master who guides me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Holding your teachings close to my heart, I will continue to dedicate myself to my training.
...Osu!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Delight... Knowing that the very source of my pride
was displayed before none other than your eyes
brings a truly exceptional feeling to my heart.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...If it pleases you, might I speak
a little more on our school's ways?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
*Ahem*... Now then, regarding the very origins of the Kongo Yaegaki style—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even the stern Yaeno Muteki seems to loosen her tongue
when it comes to her proud style.
I listened to her story with a fond smile.
